subject: Civic Education
competence: Explains the importance of the citizens fulfilling duties and rights related to
lesson: Explains the importance of the citizens fulfilling duties and rights related to: Teacher Activity: show video for students
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the importance of the citizens fulfilling duties and rights related to
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher writes or reads “Explains the importance of the citizens fulfilling duties and rights related to” and asks students to name one example they have seen in everyday life. Students share brief responses; the teacher connects their examples to show video for students and explains how it will help them explore this period's outcome.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher explains the importance of citizens fulfilling duties and rights, using the video as a starting point.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students listen to the teacher's explanation and take notes in their notebooks.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_method: Show video for students (Teacher's custom activity)

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Students work in groups of 7, with each group having a leader, scribe, timekeeper, and spokesperson.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students discuss and brainstorm the importance of citizens fulfilling duties and rights, using the video as a reference.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher facilitates a plenary session, where students share their group's findings and insights.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students share their group's ideas and listen to their peers' perspectives.

summary: Students will understand the importance of citizens fulfilling duties and rights.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: The teacher will provide feedback on students' participation and engagement during the group discussion and plenary session.
post_activity: In-class assignment: Students will write a short paragraph (5 minutes) explaining the importance of citizens fulfilling duties and rights, using their notes and insights from the lesson.
